---
title: Pasta and Broccoli with Fish Broth
id: MAR-0091
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 55
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 200 g of short pasta
- 1 kg of fish (ray, scorpionfish or tub gurnard)
- 400 g of broccoli
- 200 g of tomato pulp
- 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- 2 anchovy fillets in oil
- 1.5 l of fish stock
- 1 garlic clove
## Method
1. Clean the broccoli and divide into florets.
2. Clean the fish, place it in the fish kettle with the court-bouillon, bring to a boil and cook for about 20 minutes.
3. Drain the fish and serve it as a second course.
4. Strain the broth.
5. Peel the garlic and sauté it in a saucepan with the oil; after 4 minutes remove it and, off the heat, dissolve the chopped anchovy fillets in the oil.
6. Return to the heat, add the broccoli florets and the tomato pulp, stir, pour in one liter of fish stock, bring to a boil, add the pasta and cook for the necessary time.
7. Serve in a tureen.
